name: ArtiSential
description: ArtiSential is a pioneering line of handheld articulating laparoscopic surgical instruments developed by South Korean medical device manufacturer LivsMed. Designed to provide robotic-like dexterity without the capital costs, footprint, or complexity of a robotic console, ArtiSential features a multi-jointed wristed end effector that synchronizes mechanically with the surgeon's natural wrist and finger motions with 7 degrees of freedom and up to 90° of articulation. Unlike robotic platforms, ArtiSential is a purely mechanical, handheld laparoscopic instrument that potentially preserves direct tactile and force feedback. The instrument lineup includes articulating bipolar and monopolar dissectors, fenestrated forceps, needle holders, clip appliers, and vessel sealers in both 8 mm and 5 mm (ArtiSential 5) diameters for abdominal, gynecological, thoracic, and urological minimally invasive surgery.
